variants.title: Pie: category count
variants.meaning: Category count A:B = 2:1; 240° and 120°; category legend only.

variants.title: Pie: explicit weighted sum
variants.meaning: Explicit sum A:B = 5:5; 180° per sector; no axes or grid.

variants.title: Donut: ratio and padding
variants.meaning: The same 5:5 partition; inner-radius ratio 0.55 and 2° padding.

variants.title: Density: one quantitative variable
variants.meaning: One Gaussian KDE profile, 61 samples; x = value, y = density; no inferred group color.

variants.title: Density: explicit groups and color
variants.meaning: Two Gaussian KDE profiles, 122 samples; group identity and color are explicit.

variants.title: Density: horizontal orientation
variants.meaning: The same two profiles; x = density, y = value; the existing horizontal grid remains.

variants.title: Horizon: signed amplitude
variants.meaning: Seven samples, three bands per sign, six paths and 24 folded rows; x guides only.

variants.title: Horizon: explicit timestamps
variants.meaning: Explicit timestamps; x domain [1000, 2000]; three bands per sign and six paths.

variants.title: Horizon: baseline, bands and opacity revision
variants.meaning: Baseline 2; bands revised from 2 to 3; final opacity 0.6 after the initial 0.8.
